title: Section 180 BNSS — Examination of witnesses by police

content.heading: Police officer's power to require attendance of witnesses
content.text: Any police officer making an investigation may examine orally any person supposed to be acquainted with the facts and circumstances of the case and reduce into writing any statement made to him. Such statement is not to be signed by the person making it and is subject to the use restrictions enacted for trial. This is the successor of CrPC 161.
